profile.headline: CEO @ RegainFlow | AI Architect | Enterprise AI & RAG | Product Strategy | Technical Leadership at RegainFlow
profile.summary: Experienced Staff Fullstack Engineer and AI/ML Tech Lead with a proven record of architecting enterprise-level AI systems - including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and HCM data validation frameworks - to modernize legacy processes and optimize data pipelines for LLM readiness. Adept at securing project funding through impactful prototypes and executive demonstrations, enhancing search and validation accuracy with advanced Elasticsearch and Python MVC architectures, and integrating AI + MCP solutions for future-ready automation. Combines strong leadership and technical expertise from corporate and military environments to deliver innovative, scalable solutions and mentor cross-functional teams toward operational excellence.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Selected to lead core engineering efforts for DemoHop’s virtual booth platform, supporting enterprise clients and high-visibility corporate event experiences.

- Currently onboarding through direct knowledge transfer with the outgoing CTO, assuming ownership of backend architecture, product roadmap execution, and operational stability.

- Leading development of new platform features and enhancements using Spring Boot microservices and PostgreSQL to support scalable real-time customer event workflows.

- Overseeing infrastructure automation and deployment consistency through Terraform-managed environments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

- Partnering with leadership to maintain SOC 2 Type II compliance, supporting incident response planning, control testing, and secure engineering practices.

- Serving as primary engineering escalation point and on-standby support lead during live customer events, ensuring uptime, rapid bug resolution, and client success.

- Collaborating cross-functionally with product, customer experience, and business stakeholders to prioritize feature delivery and platform reliability.

positions.title: CEO @ RegainFlow | AI Architect | Enterprise AI & RAG | Product Strategy | Technical Leadership
positions.description:
- Cofounded an AI transformation and engineering firm and lead product strategy,
solution architecture, and hands on delivery of enterprise RAG, knowledge
intelligence, and AI evaluation systems.

- Delivered enterprise AI and RAG solutions across two mission driven environments,
government services and aerospace manufacturing, through prime led
subcontract engagements.

- Built a public safety RAG demo connected to PowerDMS that answers policy
questions with citations back to agency source documents, and shaped the
production roadmap for SSO, RBAC, auditability, document versioning, and CJIS
aware deployment.

- Designed and evolved a three generation AI evaluation harness, expanding from 10
business curated cases to bulk runs across multiple documents with field aware
scoring, connected data sources, and historical reporting backed by MetricsDB.

positions.title: Cyber Warfare Officer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Led mission-critical cyber analyst teams, effectively training 10 soldiers on advanced cybersecurity
topics.

- Provided continuous resources and mentorship, encouraging soldiers to pursue relevant cybersecurity
certifications.

- Mobilized with CPT 184 to support allied countries by teaching and implementing various cybersecurity
concepts.

positions.title: Signal Officer
positions.description:
- Led and managed communications functions supporting a battalion of 500 Soldiers.

- Installed and provided support for port drops, enabling the establishment of both unclassified and
classified environments.

- Served as principal advisor to the battalion commander, primary staff, and company commanders on all
matters related to command and control and signal operations, providing expert guidance and insights.

- Planned, coordinated, and managed automations, tactical internet, and Blue Force Trackers FBCB2
network consisting of over 50 platforms, as well as tactical satellite and FM/HF communications
systems, ensuring seamless communication and situational awareness across the battalion.

positions.title: Engineer Officer
positions.description:
- Prepared and presented detailed project cost estimates, leveraging data analysis to determine project feasibility and recommend improvements.

- Devised a comprehensive strategy for documentation, identifying design sets to be implemented at each stage of work, including as-built designs and final building information models (BIM).

- Utilized advanced engineering software and statistical packages to complete information processing tasks, including data encoding, entry, and retrieval, ensuring accurate and timely data processing for efficient project completion.

positions.title: Staff AI/ML Engineer - Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Architected and currently lead a 10-member cross-functional engineering team modernizing Lockheed’s legacy Payroll Validation System into a scalable HCM Data Validation Platform, reducing manual data comparison efforts and saving an estimated $8M annually.

- Designed and implemented an end-to-end framework engine integrating UI, API, Ingest Pipeline, and PostgreSQL DB components within a Python-based MVC architecture, automating ingestion, validation, and backup processes for SAP-driven HCM workflows.

- Developed schema onboarding logic to convert HCM mapping templates into standardized metadata-driven ingestion schemas, enabling rapid adoption of new use cases across multiple business areas.

- Integrated with SAP Facade Layer APIs to synchronize validation logic across HCM and downstream Business Analytics Systems (BAS), ensuring data integrity and consistency across payroll operations.

- Implemented metrics, observability, and progress dashboards for HCM and BAS teams, improving visibility into validation runs, ingestion status, and audit readiness.

- Led the introduction of an AI + MCP (Multi-Component Protocol) proof-of-concept, demonstrating the potential for AI-assisted rule generation and validation automation in future HCM modernization phases.

- Partnered with HCM leadership and developers to convert previously manual validation workflows into a reusable automation engine, establishing a foundation for scalable, intelligent data governance across HR systems.

positions.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
positions.description:
- Secured funding by delivering a robust Agentic RAG solution capable of processing queries and
uploaded documents for enterprise use, showcasing its potential to streamline advanced questionand-
answer capabilities.

- Built an Agentic RAG framework using LangGraph, integrating document loaders with Vision-
Language Models (VLMs) for summarization, decision-making logic for vectorized search, chat
history management, and document grading to rank sources based on query relevance.

- Developed and fine-tuned the RAG system with scoring evaluations, reranking algorithms, and
an iterative hallucination detection grader to refine LLM-generated responses, achieving highly
accurate and reliable outputs.

- Developed an enterprise-level Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to enhance search
functionalities across over 1 million records, incorporating an ETL processor to feed and ingest
unstructured data into Elasticsearch for LLM readiness.

- Optimized hybrid search functionality in Elasticsearch by implementing advanced chunking
strategies, BM25, Dense Vectorization, Sparse Vectorization, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
techniques, ensuring efficient retrieval of semantically relevant documents.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Provided technical and strategic support to cross-functional teams, enhancing application
development and ensuring project success through collaboration and resource optimization.

- Advocated for team initiatives by engaging with executives and leadership, securing funding
through compelling prototypes and demonstrations that showcased the feasibility and value of
proposed projects.

- Conducted engaging product demonstrations of AI solutions, highlighting their capabilities in
addressing business challenges and driving organizational decision-making.

- Migrated and improved legacy products to enhance maintainability and ensure long-term
operational feasibility, streamlining processes for Operations and Maintenance (O&M).

- Collaborated with vendors to educate teams on Elasticsearch capabilities, fostering the
development of AI-driven solutions and organization-wide adoption of advanced technologies.
